summary.criterion: For each legal move, score-change is the condition's final absolute MBON score minus the absent-control absolute score on the same board/action under the same encoder cap. Rank descending with lexical UCI tie-break. For informative memory, both success moves must rank strictly better (smaller rank) than their recorded cap-14 rank for the cap-increase hypothesis to pass. Shuffled-minus-absent and disabled-minus-absent ranks are reported as controls, not substituted for the informative criterion.
summary.interpretation: This compares informative-minus-absent score-change ranks on two already inspected development probes. It is not independent transfer, a biological plasticity test, or a solution to the all-legal choice failure.

coverage: Complete all-legal action assessment; no training, feedback events, or memory updates.
